reviews.comment: She is so sweet and for lack of words, an icon. Shes funny and makes class fun, i definitely recommend!!

For the online summer class, there are 4 quizzes, 5 reflections and 3 opportunities for extra credit. She drops your lowest quiz and lowest reflection grade. Which helps your overall grade ALOT. She's a great professor, grades and responds quickly.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I absolutely LOVE her. She is the best professor I have ever had. Not only does she make her lectures amazing, you actually like them and enjoy going to her class. She genuinely likes teaching and she makes the classes absolutely hilarious. I would definitely take her class again if I could.
She's amazing!! I recommend taking her class. She makes philosophy much more interesting. Lot's of good useful information.

Dr. Leckey is really down to earth. There is A LOT of reading for this class, but a lot of group and class discussion to help for better understanding. Very glad I chose her class and would take her again for Ethics if it was part of my degree plan.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Leckey is great! The content is really interesting and a good overview of philosophy. She is funny and sarcastic, and genuinely cares about her students. She grades easily so as long as you try, you'll get an A. This is the only class I have never wanted to leave.

Dr. Leckey is without a doubt the best professor. She cares more than anything about her students. Her lectures are fun and enjoyable! I LOVED going to class. She gives you any and ALL information you need for quizzes and the two exams. Read before class, so you can participate in the discussions - they're always interesting. I'll miss her so much.

Dr. Leckey is a very intelligent professor. Critical thinking is definitely in her cards. She encourages discussion ( then met with silence). The lectures are intriguing for the most part, though there are some topics that might bore you. Overall this was one of my favorite classes this semester. If you just read and take notes, you'll get an A.

Professor Leckey Is an Amazing teacher. Although you have to come to class and read all the things she assigns, you can easily make an A. Her tests are completely short answer but don't let that scare you away because she will tell you EVERYTHING that will be on the exam ahead of time including the essay prompts. If you need PHIL 111 TAKE HER!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: One of the best profs at A&M. She relates well to her students and wants to see them succeed. Her lectures are very well thought out & her goal is to create an open class discussion for students to learn from one another. She is super funny & her assignments are easy so long as you come to class and pay attention. Would love to take again!

Not exaggerating when I say Dr. Leckey is the best professor I've ever had. The readings are not long and as long as you do them and go to class, it's an easy A. She takes the time to learn her students' names, is reachable outside of class, and is incredibly relatable. She knows how to make her students want to care about philosophy.
Dr. Leckey has been my favorite professor here! As long as you do the readings and pay attention, you should do well and really enjoy your time in this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Brittany is easily the best teacher I've had in my educational career. She truly cares about enhancing your life through the teachings of philosophy, that of which she is very passionate. The class is not difficult given that you do the readings, and she is more than willing to meet outside of class. I'd definitely take her again and again.

Easily the best professor at TAMU!!!! She loves philosophy and actually takes the time to get to know her students! If you do your part for the class, it should be a breeze! I would take her for every class if I could!!!! TAKE HER CLASS, YOU WON'T REGRET IT!!!

She is very passionate about what she is teaching and is very helpful if you get confused! Hilarious, love to hear her talk. She gives you two weeks to write two essays. Has a few quizzes every week over the readings, but they are super easy if you do your part and read! I LOVE HER AND I LOVE THIS CLASS!
